description: Permanent architectural specification governing canonical validation authority, external knowledge authoring identity (ChatGPT), authoring pack intake, gap requests, and anti-hallucination invariants for Aeternum Atlas.

canonical_source_distinction.source_id_definition: A specific bibliographic, institutional, or officially registered anatomical text or authority (e.g. Terminologia Anatomica, Moore Clinically Oriented Anatomy, Gray's Anatomy, Testut, Latarjet).
canonical_source_distinction.corpus_version_definition: A synthesized snapshot, build, or database distribution version (e.g. AAC-2026.1-R1). It is an engineering artifact, NOT independent bibliographic evidence.
canonical_source_distinction.rule: No atomic proposition may claim canonical validation solely by self-referencing an Aeternum build corpus version. All validation must resolve to an underlying registered SOURCE_ID manifest entry.

CANONICAL_PRIMARY.description: Primary international normative anatomical standards (e.g. IFAA/FIPAT Terminologia Anatomica 2).
CANONICAL_PRIMARY.authority: Definitive for terminology and standard systematic boundaries.

CANONICAL_SECONDARY.description: Standard peer-reviewed international reference textbooks (e.g. Gray's Anatomy, Moore Clinically Oriented Anatomy, Netter, Latarjet, Testut).
CANONICAL_SECONDARY.authority: Standard reference for descriptive morphology, syntopy, and relations.

INSTITUTIONAL_TEACHING.description: Cadaveric laboratory dissection guides, morgue prosection handouts, and professor practical notes (e.g. MORGUE-UPPER-LIMB-001).
INSTITUTIONAL_TEACHING.authority: Pedagogical and cadaveric reality layer. Must preserve teaching dynamics and slips without overwriting canonical models.

TERMINOLOGY_AUTHORITY.description: Official anatomical nomenclature registries (e.g. TA2, FIPAT, Federative International Programme on Anatomical Terminologies).
TERMINOLOGY_AUTHORITY.authority: Normative for Latin, English, and Portuguese anatomical synonyms and eponym retirement.

INTERNAL_CURATED.description: Peer-reviewed, fully validated Aeternum consensus dossiers possessing verified multi-source evidence.

AI_AUTHORED_DRAFT.description: Synthesized knowledge proposals generated by Knowledge Author (ChatGPT) pending verification.
AI_AUTHORED_DRAFT.authority: Candidate ingestion layer only. Never automatically canonical.

SYNTHETIC_QA.description: Test fixtures, regression sets, and synthetic probing scenarios.
SYNTHETIC_QA.authority: Evaluation only. Forbidden from entering canonical memory.

knowledge_author_identity.nature: Anatomical authoring and pedagogical synthesis layer.

draft_classifications.AI_DRAFT: Authored from domain intelligence without explicit registered source citation. Must never enter canonical memory directly.
draft_classifications.SOURCE_GROUNDED_DRAFT: Authored with explicit citations to approved registered Aeternum source IDs. Starts as candidate pending Antigravity and Quality Engine validation.

morgue_canonical_duality.principle: Preserve practical/cadaveric teaching observations alongside canonical anatomical truth without mutual erasure.

mandatory_criteria: Explicit source lineage down to specific page/location.
Source must be formally registered in Aeternum manifest.
Source usage must be authorized under governance rules.
Evidence must substantiate the exact atomic proposition.
Formal VALIDATION_ASSESSMENT record with deterministic ID exists.
canonical_validation_contract.prohibition: Zero validation by corpus self-reference (e.g. citing AAC-2026.1-R1 as proof of itself).

anti_hallucination_rule.rule_statement: ANTIGRAVITY MUST NOT AUTHOR MISSING ANATOMICAL KNOWLEDGE.
anti_hallucination_rule.mandatory_behavior: When an anatomical gap is identified, Antigravity must emit a KNOWLEDGE_GAP_REQUEST or flag MISSING_KNOWLEDGE. Under no circumstances may Antigravity synthesize ungrounded anatomy to pass validation gates.

quality_engine_role.prohibition: Must not synthesize facts merely to achieve arbitrary test counts.

handshake_pipeline: 1. Knowledge Author deposits Knowledge Pack in knowledge_base/authoring/inbox/pending/
3. Antigravity performs provenance verification and source manifest check
4. Antigravity executes terminology matching and canonical ID normalization
5. Antigravity detects duplicates across active corpus and pending packs
6. Antigravity verifies relational consistency and topological constraints
7. Quality Engine qualifies academic status and generates validation queue
8. Pack is moved to qualified/ or rejected/; canonical promotion occurs only at formal release gate
